observations.action: Decode ?parameters= key NAMES of thank-you links (values not recorded)
observations.observed_result: parameters = standard base64 (not url-safe) of a JSON object; decodable client-side (not signed visibly). Multi-unbox link keys: order_id (string, 13 digits), customer_id (number), token (string, 64 chars, not hex-only), path (string, starts with "/", equals the link pathname), openAll (boolean). Unbox link keys: order_id, customer_id, token, path (== pathname), box_version_id (number, equals the URL segment). order_id equals the order id segment in the path. Links generated by the app for in-portal navigation (order detail / orders list) carry only keys token and customer_id. The token and customer_id values in O1 and O2 links are identical (SHA-256 prefix comparison in-page) -> token is customer-scoped, not order-scoped.
